subject: Risk & Compliance
title: WorldCom's $11 Billion Lie
description: A short lesson to help you apply WorldCom's $11 Billion Lie.

hook.text: WorldCom inflated profits by $11 billion. It was the largest accounting fraud in US history at the time.

buildup.text: Executives capitalized operating expenses to make profits look higher. Basic accounting tricks, massive scale.

discovery.text: An internal auditor named Cynthia Cooper found the fraud by working nights to avoid detection.

twist.text: WorldCom's external auditor, Arthur Andersen (also Enron's auditor), missed everything.

climax.text: WorldCom filed the largest bankruptcy in US history. CEO Bernie Ebbers got 25 years in prison.

punchline.text: $11 billion fabricated. An internal auditor found it at night.

quiz.question: Who discovered WorldCom's accounting fraud?
options: The SEC during a routine audit
